Senses.Explanation: Lang Shangzuo says that a thousand days in office can be lost in one morning after overturning the tea kettle and being asked how the hearth deity allowed it. The governor walks out; Mingzhao says Lang has eaten Zhaoqing's rice only to make a wild display elsewhere. Yuanwu Keqin, Lingrui Kuifu, and Yuejiang Zhengyin each raise the spill and test whether Lang's proverb saved or lost the encounter.

Senses.PreferredTarget: Move, and you bury yourself a thousand fathoms; stay still, and sprouts rise where you stand
AlternateTargets: In motion you sink a thousand fathoms; in stillness shoots grow right where you are
SearchAliases: move buried a thousand fathoms stay still sprouts grow
motion and stillness both trap the walker
Senses.Note: Yunju sets a dilemma: moving buries one deep, while remaining still lets shoots grow at the very spot. Wansong reuses the pair and adds that both ends must be released before going on. Guting and Hansong comment on Yunju’s wider address; Sanyi, Liangting, and Shenfeng take up Wansong’s restatement. The sprouts are a figurative sign of getting stuck, so the line refuses an easy choice between motion and stillness.

Senses.Explanation: Movement carries on the old road without collapsing into silent stillness. The line belongs to Xiangyan's awakening verse and is repeatedly quoted or answered when visible action and quiet cannot be treated as competing mechanisms. Xiangyan's verse places the line after the sound of tile striking bamboo and before having no tracks anywhere. Shoushan uses it in answer to Fengxue and receives approval; Tianran quotes the verse in a public address, while Miaoyun gives the line directly during his interview with Jieshan.

Senses.Explanation: Stir a thought and at once deviate functions as a compact verdict, frequently paired with 擬心即差, ‘form an intention and at once err.’ Huangbo says that it is immediately this, yet stirring a thought misses, then compares what he has described to measureless space. Linji gives the paired formula and says that one who understands is not apart from what is before the eyes. The records explicitly prevent the negative wording from becoming an instruction simply to suppress thought: Shimen Cizhao says that neither intending nor moving is doing business in dead water, and Huanglong says it is no different from wood and earth and calls for a turning phrase. Linye Tongqi gives the headword as his answer to how one should finally approach; when asked about not stirring thought, he replies that the eyebrows are above the eyes. The formula therefore marks the deviation introduced by a conceptual move without making inert nonmovement its solution.

Senses.Explanation: The four-character formula is a conventional wish for well-being in all activity and rest. Occurrences.Kwic: 山問侍者：「師叔在否？」者云：「已去也。」山云：「去時有甚麼語？」者云：「無語。」山云：「莫道無語，其聲如雷。」師拈云：「隱峰未到溈山，不妨令人疑著；及乎到來，便見弄巧成拙。殊不知兩箇漢總被侍者看破，秪如溈山末後道箇其聲如雷，還覺腦門重麼？前箭猶輕後箭深。」頌：絲綸號令各全提，虎驟龍驤列陣威。寸刃不施邦自靖，干戈原是太平基。丹霞訪古寺，值喫粥次，行者盛一缽與寺，又盛一碗自喫，殊不顧霞。霞自盛粥喫，者云：「五更侵早起，更有早行人。」霞問寺云：「何不教訓行者，得恁麼無禮？」寺云：「淨地上不可點污人家男女。」霞云：「幾不問過者老漢。」師拈云：「不上高山，不知山之孤峻；不經大海，焉知水之瀰泓？孤迥迥，卓巍巍，一段穩密家風，卻被外人覷破。正眼觀來，世諦即不無，佛法太遠在。然雖如是，不因楊得億，爭見馬相如？」頌：眼中有翳須挑撥，鏡上無塵不用磨。幸自一天星月朗，何堪平地起風波。馬祖因石臼初參，祖問：「甚處來？」臼云：「烏臼來。」祖云：「烏臼有何言句？」臼云：「幾人於此茫然？」祖云：「茫然且置，悄然一句作麼生？」臼近前三步，祖云：「我有七棒寄打烏臼，你還甘麼？」臼云：「和尚先喫，某甲後甘。」師拈云：「動絃別曲，葉落知秋，人平不語，水平不流。石臼恁麼且置，馬祖節文且道意在於何？會麼？金簇慣調曾百戰，鐵鞭多力恨無仇。」頌：茫然與悄然，倒卻門前舊剎竿。悄然與茫然，釋尊光射阿難扃。明賞罰，別機先。珊瑚戴月枝枝秀，瑪瑙盤珠顆顆圓。鏡清在雪峰普請次，峰問云：「溈山道：『見色便見心』。還有過也無？」清云：「古人與麼道那？」峰云：「雖然如是，我要共你商量。」清云：「若與麼，不如某甲钁地去。」師拈云：「見色便見心，推人入火坑，還有過也無？一條拄杖兩人扶。不如钁地去，一道神光輝劫外。試問諸禪如何會？會則任會，切忌依艸附木。」頌：見色見心，口是禍門，金屑雖貴，落眼成塵。清溪巖畔，火種刀耕，生涯一钁從來足，渴飲饑餐孰道貧？箇事何愁俱爛卻，堂前丈艸任從深。馬祖因鄧隱峰辭，祖問云：「甚處去？」峰云：「石頭去。」祖云：「石頭路滑。」峰云：「竿木隨身，逢場作戲。」便去到石頭，遶禪床三匝，振錫而立，問云：「是何宗旨？」頭云：「蒼天！蒼天！」峰無語，卻回舉似馬祖，祖云：「汝更去問，待他有答，汝便噓兩聲。」峰又去問，頭噓兩聲，峰又無語，歸舉似祖，祖云：「向你道石頭路滑。」師拈云：「作戲逢場，雖非分外；傳言送語，太涉周遮。此二老盡形敗露，

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 山問侍者：「師叔在否？」者云：「已去也。」山云：「去時有甚麼語？」者云：「無語。」山云：「莫道無語，其聲如雷。」師拈云：「隱峰未到溈山，不妨令人疑著；及乎到來，便見弄巧成拙。殊不知兩箇漢總被侍者看破，秪如溈山末後道箇其聲如雷，還覺腦門重麼？前箭猶輕後箭深。」頌：絲綸號令各全提，虎驟龍驤列陣威。寸刃不施邦自靖，干戈原是太平基。丹霞訪古寺，值喫粥次，行者盛一缽與寺，又盛一碗自喫，殊不顧霞。霞自盛粥喫，者云：「五更侵早起，更有早行人。」霞問寺云：「何不教訓行者，得恁麼無禮？」寺云：「淨地上不可點污人家男女。」霞云：「幾不問過者老漢。」師拈云：「不上高山，不知山之孤峻；不經大海，焉知水之瀰泓？孤迥迥，卓巍巍，一段穩密家風，卻被外人覷破。正眼觀來，世諦即不無，佛法太遠在。然雖如是，不因楊得億，爭見馬相如？」頌：眼中有翳須挑撥，鏡上無塵不用磨。幸自一天星月朗，何堪平地起風波。馬祖因石臼初參，祖問：「甚處來？」臼云：「烏臼來。」祖云：「烏臼有何言句？」臼云：「幾人於此茫然？」祖云：「茫然且置，悄然一句作麼生？」臼近前三步，祖云：「我有七棒寄打烏臼，你還甘麼？」臼云：「和尚先喫，某甲後甘。」師拈云：「動絃別曲，葉落知秋，人平不語，水平不流。石臼恁麼且置，馬祖節文且道意在於何？會麼？金簇慣調曾百戰，鐵鞭多力恨無仇。」頌：茫然與悄然，倒卻門前舊剎竿。悄然與茫然，釋尊光射阿難扃。明賞罰，別機先。珊瑚戴月枝枝秀，瑪瑙盤珠顆顆圓。鏡清在雪峰普請次，峰問云：「溈山道：『見色便見心』。還有過也無？」清云：「古人與麼道那？」峰云：「雖然如是，我要共你商量。」清云：「若與麼，不如某甲钁地去。」師拈云：「見色便見心，推人入火坑，還有過也無？一條拄杖兩人扶。不如钁地去，一道神光輝劫外。試問諸禪如何會？會則任會，切忌依艸附木。」頌：見色見心，口是禍門，金屑雖貴，落眼成塵。清溪巖畔，火種刀耕，生涯一钁從來足，渴飲饑餐孰道貧？箇事何愁俱爛卻，堂前丈艸任從深。馬祖因鄧隱峰辭，祖問云：「甚處去？」峰云：「石頭去。」祖云：「石頭路滑。」峰云：「竿木隨身，逢場作戲。」便去到石頭，遶禪床三匝，振錫而立，問云：「是何宗旨？」頭云：「蒼天！蒼天！」峰無語，卻回舉似馬祖，祖云：「汝更去問，待他有答，汝便噓兩聲。」峰又去問，頭噓兩聲，峰又無語，歸舉似祖，祖云：「向你道石頭路滑。」師拈云：「作戲逢場，雖非分外；傳言送語，太涉周遮。此二老盡形敗露，

Senses.PreferredTarget: Move like drifting clouds; rest like the spirit of the valley
AlternateTargets: In motion, be like passing clouds; at rest, like the valley spirit
SearchAliases: move like clouds rest like valley spirit Zen
drifting clouds valley spirit movement rest
Senses.Note: Clouds move without clinging to a place, while the valley spirit images a still presence. Masters pair them when discussing departure, return, and residence. Several speakers immediately ask what going or staying means in their own circumstances, so the image points to an unforced relation to both rather than prescribing constant travel.

Occurrences.Kwic: 家舍。拈主丈，兩箇漢鼻孔總被雙峰穿却了也。卓主丈，不經一事，不長一智。上堂。孟夏已過半月，普天匝地漸熱。衲僧鼻直眼橫，那箇皮下無血？九旬禁足安居，剛道憐鵝護雪。更說克期取證，大似虗空釘橛。煑砂未必成飯，陽焰如何止渴？雙峰無可論量，一句為君直截。但能無事於心，自然應時應節。擊拂子，下座。上堂：六月雨，無價寶。高田低田水盈盈，早禾晚禾雲緲緲。農夫聚首話年豐，斗米三錢端可保。衲僧家，沒頭腦。飽飯噇眠，知恩者少。解夏，小參。布袋頭捻聚放開，吞却山河大地；主丈子橫來竪去，挑幹日月星辰。如理如事，全主全賓，風流直是風流，奇特不妨奇特。拍禪床，行到水窮處，坐看雲起時。復舉：教中道：八十誦律，一夏之功，不階四果，必證三禪。師云：把本修行，如驢拽磨，衲僧家合作麼生？良久：有口只堪閒掛壁。上堂。提起數珠，云：百八摩尼一串穿，今年又數到明年，明年又是從頭起，百八摩尼一串穿。大眾且道：前不停五、後不至七，畢竟如何？嘉州大像喫鹽多，陝府鐵牛添得渴。上堂：動若行雲，止猶谷神。休將北斗，喚作南辰。只如山僧一月以來，半出半入，或東或西，畢竟成得什麼邊事？回首紅塵沒馬深，行人更在青山外。上堂，舉雲門拈主丈示眾云：主丈子化為龍，吞却乾坤了也，山河大地甚處得來？先師東巖和尚拈云：天童亦有主丈子，雖不曾變化，直是易見難識。擲下主丈云：向道是龍剛不信，待為霖雨始應知。師拈主丈召大眾云：物見主眼卓，竪卓主丈，只知開口易，不覺舌頭長。上堂。寒山子詩云：白鶴㗸苦花，千里作一息，欲往蓬萊山，將此充糧食。好諸禪德！向者裡瞥地者多，錯會者亦不少。所以道：我詩也是詩，有人喚作偈，詩偈總一般，讀時須仔細。九日，上堂。今朝九月九，相喚不出手，若是箇中人，舉意便知有。拍禪床，云：金鷄飛上玉䦨干，一聲啼破千峰曉。上堂，舉：馬祖翫月次，智藏、百丈、南泉侍立，祖曰：正與麼時如何？藏云：正好脩行。丈云：正好供養。南泉拂袖便去。祖云：經歸藏，禪歸海，唯有普願獨超物外。師云：馬大師一家父子，只解貪觀天上月，不知失却手中橈。雙峰則不然，正與麼時如何？青天也須喫棒。都道場看經歸，上堂：一大藏教是箇切脚，且道切甚麼字？諸仁者，出一叢林、入一保社，一七日內朝看暮閱，還有覰得透底麼？若覰得透，非唯仰報聖恩，抑亦慶快自己；若覰不透，被黑荳子換却眼睛了

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 家舍。拈主丈，兩箇漢鼻孔總被雙峰穿却了也。卓主丈，不經一事，不長一智。上堂。孟夏已過半月，普天匝地漸熱。衲僧鼻直眼橫，那箇皮下無血？九旬禁足安居，剛道憐鵝護雪。更說克期取證，大似虗空釘橛。煑砂未必成飯，陽焰如何止渴？雙峰無可論量，一句為君直截。但能無事於心，自然應時應節。擊拂子，下座。上堂：六月雨，無價寶。高田低田水盈盈，早禾晚禾雲緲緲。農夫聚首話年豐，斗米三錢端可保。衲僧家，沒頭腦。飽飯噇眠，知恩者少。解夏，小參。布袋頭捻聚放開，吞却山河大地；主丈子橫來竪去，挑幹日月星辰。如理如事，全主全賓，風流直是風流，奇特不妨奇特。拍禪床，行到水窮處，坐看雲起時。復舉：教中道：八十誦律，一夏之功，不階四果，必證三禪。師云：把本修行，如驢拽磨，衲僧家合作麼生？良久：有口只堪閒掛壁。上堂。提起數珠，云：百八摩尼一串穿，今年又數到明年，明年又是從頭起，百八摩尼一串穿。大眾且道：前不停五、後不至七，畢竟如何？嘉州大像喫鹽多，陝府鐵牛添得渴。上堂：動若行雲，止猶谷神。休將北斗，喚作南辰。只如山僧一月以來，半出半入，或東或西，畢竟成得什麼邊事？回首紅塵沒馬深，行人更在青山外。上堂，舉雲門拈主丈示眾云：主丈子化為龍，吞却乾坤了也，山河大地甚處得來？先師東巖和尚拈云：天童亦有主丈子，雖不曾變化，直是易見難識。擲下主丈云：向道是龍剛不信，待為霖雨始應知。師拈主丈召大眾云：物見主眼卓，竪卓主丈，只知開口易，不覺舌頭長。上堂。寒山子詩云：白鶴㗸苦花，千里作一息，欲往蓬萊山，將此充糧食。好諸禪德！向者裡瞥地者多，錯會者亦不少。所以道：我詩也是詩，有人喚作偈，詩偈總一般，讀時須仔細。九日，上堂。今朝九月九，相喚不出手，若是箇中人，舉意便知有。拍禪床，云：金鷄飛上玉䦨干，一聲啼破千峰曉。上堂，舉：馬祖翫月次，智藏、百丈、南泉侍立，祖曰：正與麼時如何？藏云：正好脩行。丈云：正好供養。南泉拂袖便去。祖云：經歸藏，禪歸海，唯有普願獨超物外。師云：馬大師一家父子，只解貪觀天上月，不知失却手中橈。雙峰則不然，正與麼時如何？青天也須喫棒。都道場看經歸，上堂：一大藏教是箇切脚，且道切甚麼字？諸仁者，出一叢林、入一保社，一七日內朝看暮閱，還有覰得透底麼？若覰得透，非唯仰報聖恩，抑亦慶快自己；若覰不透，被黑荳子換却眼睛了

Senses.Explanation: The saying pairs free movement with quiet rest. Miyun and Wanru use the pair while describing travel and residence without fixed attachment. Chulin brings it into an end-of-retreat address, and Qianshan speaks it when parting and gathering. Shanyi uses the image on retiring from his post; Pingshi asks what a month of moving east and west has accomplished.

Senses.Explanation: Movement and stillness is the paired range of activity and quiet, often widened to cover speech, silence, work, and rest. Yongming Yanshou asks for their source; Fozhi Zhikai says movement and stillness are one; Yongjue Yuanxian compares them to a ring without a beginning. Zhongfeng Mingben says to keep striking through movement, stillness, leisure, and hurry; Juelang Dasheng lists speech and silence with movement and stillness; Changming Jiong tests a line that does not rely on either.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J29/J29nB235.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Lianyue. Lianyue Daozheng owns the retained address: he raised the whisk — the teaching never rises alone; it takes a ground to be born — then drew a circle with it: true awakening has no name or form; follow the conditions, and there is the seat of the way. From the founders on, all have built their gates inside this one seat, each setting out his own device — the flower raised, the wall faced, the tablet danced, the ball bowled — no two holdings alike. This mountain monk today will not go circling outside either; he runs one straight rule, bent only on making all of you see a resting place on the spot — only, do not catch at echoes. The whisk flung down, one shout: a thousand skills all spring rain — one shout like thunder wakes the hibernating dragon.

Senses.Explanation: The teaching never rises alone; it takes a ground to be born — the couplet that opens an occasion and then gets its footing pulled. Zhangxue Tongzui, pulling the couplet's footing: the teaching never rises alone; it takes a ground to be born — but if the ground is not there at all, from where would the teaching stand? the whisk raised — this is the ground, what is the teaching? — flung down: thrown on the sweepings-heap, for the rain to beat and the wind to blow away. Jie'an Jin, at the small-meeting: the teaching never rises alone; it takes a ground to be born — since Wujin came to Jinming, door shut six years, sick through the seasons, and now the officers press a sick monk to close the retreat: no wood, no rice, no greens, utterly empty — the roaming monks split their lips laughing; an old case is raised — Muzhou egging Linji on, not a kind heart; Yangqi asking Ciming to the evening meeting, not a kind heart — tonight's pressing, kind heart or not? try to settle it. Lianyue Daozheng, at the restored monastery: whisk raised — the teaching never rises alone; it takes a ground to be born — a circle drawn in the air: true awakening has no name or form; follow the conditions, and there is the seat of the way; the founders all built their gates inside this one seat — flower raised, wall faced, tablet danced, ball bowled — this mountain monk runs one straight rule: see a resting place on the spot, only do not catch at echoes; the whisk flung down, one shout: a thousand skills all spring rain, one shout like thunder wakes the hibernating dragon. Huijue Yi, for the layman of Pingshan: the teaching never rises alone; it takes a ground to be born — if the ground is not there, from where would the teaching stand? the turd-stub, three pounds of hemp, the radish-head, the cypress tree — what of these? the staff rapped: strung through, all on one string. Senses.Explanation: A senior brother in the teaching is a respectful kinship title for a fellow in the teaching who is treated as the elder brother. Luo Kailin uses the title for Miaoyun Zhenxiong in a biography; Chezhong addresses Zhulang Chesheng with it in a preface; Pinjixiang Zhixiang applies it to Zhong'an while identifying his lineage; and Liao'an Qingyu places it in a poem title for Zhongmou. Senses.Explanation: A lineage heir is the person selected or recognized to continue a teaching line. Qianyan Yuanzhang describes picking one person from thousands, ‘like lamp lighting lamp, like water joining water,’ and calls that the reason for the designation. Tang Shiji counts twelve such heirs of Miyun Yuanwu; the Shunzhi Emperor asks whose heir Wunian is; and Chuiwan Guangzhen contrasts this role with Muzhou’s having none. The term names the person, not merely a later genealogy’s claim about one.

Senses.Note: The recurrent question “from whom did you obtain lineage succession?” (得法嗣何人) must not be paraphrased globally as “obtain lineage heirs.” The related verbal construction is “inherit the lineage from X” (嗣法於X) in its own entry.

Senses.Explanation: The succession relation or lineage affiliation itself, rather than the person who is an heir. Catalogues append people “whose lineage succession is not detailed” (未詳法嗣者); an unnamed questioner asks from whom Shexian Guisheng obtained lineage succession (師今得法嗣何人); and the messenger Wenxiang carries a written succession document (法嗣書) to Wuzu Fayan. The relation is not accepted merely because a later genealogy records it: Dahui Zonggao recounts Gaoting Jian's later succession to Deshan Xuanjian, then says that if Gaoting is to succeed Deshan, it is “not yet acceptable” because he is still separated from Deshan by the river. A single “lineage heir” gloss cannot describe an unknown affiliation, a succession document, or the predication “succeed Deshan” without changing the referent.

Senses.Note: The witnesses cover delivery, public receipt, a catalogue title, and a hall occasion; they identify a document rather than a distinct teaching formula.

Senses.PreferredTarget: If the ground of the teaching moves, nothing remains at ease
SearchAliases: if the ground of the teaching moves, nothing remains at ease
Senses.Note: When Emperor Wu enters during a lecture, Fu Dashi remains seated. Asked why he does not rise, he says that if the ground of the teaching moves, nothing remains at ease. Chushi replies that Fu Dashi has sat so long he cannot get up; Tianyin challenges both that criticism and the act of sitting. Touzi asks what a sound response to the ruler would require, while Linquan weighs the cost of an incomplete move. The line becomes a case about steadiness and responsive action.

Occurrences.Kwic: 復舉：智者銓和尚示眾云：要扣玄關，須是有節操、極慷慨，斬得釘、截得鐵，硬剝剝地漢始得。若是畏刀避箭之徒，看即有分。師云：大小智者用盡自己心，笑破他人口。壽山別無奇特，朝晨熱水洗面，黃昏脫襪打睡，大海從魚躍，長空任鳥飛。上堂：日裏閙浩浩，不妨靜悄悄；夜間靜悄悄，不妨閙浩浩。靜的閙的，輥作一團，是業識？是佛性？喝一喝。中秋，上堂。天上月圓，人間月半。古人道：赫日猶虧半，烏沉始得圓。且那一半落在什麼處？更深夜靜，共伊商量。上堂，舉：傅大士云：法地若動，一切不安。師云：壽山從朝至暮，不知走了幾遭。若是法地，誰敢動著一莖草？復云：我不爭恁麼道，傅大士坐了起不得。上堂。此事如一隻手相似，開也在我、合也在我、伸也在我、縮也在我，只是不許喚作手。若喚作手，頭上安頭；不喚作手，斬頭覔活。畢竟喚作什麼？總道不得，壽山通袖去也。便下座。上堂：三通鼓罷，一炷香焚。老僧坐定，諸人總立。古人道：目前無闍棃，座上無老僧。意作麼生？莫是一切皆空麼？莫是泡幻之質終歸敗壞麼？莫是有形有相便是無形無相麼？莫是正恁麼時全明向

Senses.Explanation: Outside phenomena there is no mind is one half of a reciprocal mind-and-phenomena formula denying an independently located mind or teaching-object. Yongming Yanshou uses it to block both permanence and annihilation. Baichi Xingyuan states the reciprocal pair directly in a hall address. Huangbo Xiyun gives the same formula and continues that mind itself is no-mind, while Zhongfeng Mingben uses it in an answer on post-awakening practice. The phrase does not license a new hidden substance called mind.

Senses.Explanation: A lineage grandson is a descendant in the generation below a teacher's direct lineage heirs, expressed through the family term “grandson.” Poshan Haiming calls Songyun “my lineage grandson,” and Yuanwu Keqin identifies Min as Vinaya Master Fazhao's lineage-grandson. Forest Notes uses the same term when comparing written succession lists, while several recorded-sayings books identify their compilers as lineage-grandsons of the recorded master.

Senses.Explanation: (法座) is the teaching seat used for a public address. Records describe the assembly surrounding it, Feiyin Tongrong and Yuanwu Keqin pointing to it before ascending, and the sequence of pointing to the seat, taking it, and ascending it. In those scenes the seat marks the physical and institutional place from which the gathered assembly is addressed. A contents-list witness has no independent lexical force; the defining evidence is the narrated ascent and the masters’ own pointing to the seat.

Senses.Explanation: A public teaching assembly is a gathered occasion where the presiding master addresses, tests, or formally directs an audience; the records mark its convening, attendance, descent, and conclusion. Tianyin Yuanxiu raises the case of Pei Xiu convening such an assembly; Wuming Huijing tells those who have come before the assembly to put the teaching first; Fushi Tongxian says an assembly is not lightly gathered; Sanyi Mingyu speaks of the assembly gathering like clouds; Shiyu Mingfang names the gathered congregation; Tian’an Sheng describes forms descending upon the assembly; Dahui Zonggao says local officials and residents came together to the same assembly to hear him speak.

Entries.SourceTerm: 法本法無法，無法法亦法

Senses.PreferredTarget: The original teaching is no fixed teaching; no teaching too is teaching
AlternateTargets: At its root the teaching is without a fixed teaching, yet this absence itself functions as teaching
SearchAliases: Buddha transmission verse original teaching no fixed teaching
no teaching too is teaching Kasyapa verse Chan
Senses.Note: The cited verse says that the original teaching is no fixed teaching and that no teaching also functions as teaching. Its later two lines turn to the act of handing it on. Hanyue, Jifei, Miyun, Tianyin, Feiyin, and Juelang each interpret or deploy the verse in a separate recorded work. Their questions and gestures focus on what passes to Kasyapa without turning it into a fixed object. The exact old words are attributed to Shakyamuni, not to these later commentators.

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 忽有人問：『恁麼也不得，是如何？』山僧便答云：『且信一半。』又云：『不恁麼也不得，又如何？』山僧亦答云：『低聲低聲。』又問：『恁麼不恁麼總不得，是如何？』山僧又答云：『逢人但恁麼舉。』且道山僧如此拈提意在於何？」良久云：「數聲羌笛離亭晚，君向瀟湘我向秦。」遂喝一喝，卓拄杖下座。鹽城縣永寧寺大機上座齎當道鄉紳書請師過本寺授戒，于四月八日本縣中尊同各官及眾鄉紳請上堂，師陞座拈香畢，乃云：「佛法週遍一切處，一切處週遍佛法，老僧到者裏，還有探竿影草者麼？若有請出來與老僧相見。」眾不出，乃云：「既無，自拈自舉去也。」復云：「佛佛授手，祖祖相傳，西天七四，東土三二，自曹溪鑒傳南嶽讓，讓傳馬祖一，一傳百丈海，海傳黃檗運，運傳臨濟玄，玄傳興化獎乃至首山念，念傳汾陽昭，昭傳石霜圓，圓傳楊岐會，會傳白雲端，端傳五祖演，演傳圓悟勤，雲礽繼起，奕葉相承，及六十七世傳到先師上密下雲老和尚，于人天眾前傳與山僧。且道傳底是甚麼意旨？豈不見釋迦老子最初便云：『法本法無法，無法法亦法，今付無法時，法法何曾法。』自後諸祖迭興，雖有玄機妙用，棒喝交馳，語言敲磕，七縱八橫，莫非顯發無相心印、正法眼藏，以致人天集會、四眾皈依，開豁見聞，明心見性以了生死。且性又作麼生見？就當人分上返而觀之，心不自心、性不自性，脫體全彰、圓同寶鏡，若官若貴、若男若女，即向者裏開悟得去、透脫將來，便與西天諸老古錐、東土一切尊宿，心心相契、念念不異，如水投水、似金博金，一即一切、一切即一，乃至動遍動、震遍震、湧遍湧、擊遍擊，以見至真之道浩然大均。雖然如是，更須曉得如人滿口含霜，更不說霜之一字。還信得及麼？無影優曇香世界，不霑雨露自芬芳。」復舉：「當時宋朝蘇東坡參佛印禪師，印云：『此間無坐處。』坡曰：『借和尚四大為禪床。』印云：『今有一問，若答得即如所請，若答不得留此玉帶以鎮山門。』東坡即解帶置几上，印云：『老僧四大本空、五蘊非有，向甚麼處坐？』東坡擬議，印即呼侍者云：『收取玉帶。』然而東坡答得甚奇，佛印問得更妙，但惜東坡末後欠一轉語，輸卻玉帶，以成話柄。若是老僧當時做東坡，見佛印云四大本空、五蘊非有，便云：『和尚這一問，從何處發來？』印若擬議，便云：『不勞再勘。』東坡若下得者兩轉語，不惟免輸玉帶，一時亦見話圓。何為如此？擔荷如來正法眼

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 。使今日濟、洞二家不得其真正宗旨，安知不踵溈仰、雲門、法眼之流弊，以致無傳乎？予於是乎懼，慨然將西天東土以至五家宗師，而會其始終之旨，為《會祖規》，以表東西密相付，曾無二法脈也。或問：師所會者，東西諸祖及五家之宗旨也，而五家之子孫全不會歸，則何處見後世之流弊哉？予曰：若廣收，則有五燈矣，又何從見吾會祖有提綱以振其目，舉直以措諸枉乎？而後世之弊，正以不悟上祖及五家之真正綱宗耳。使能悟上祖與五家真正綱宗，則心心相印、法法相承，傳於萬古。如人之眼色、耳聲、鼻香、舌味、身觸、意法等，皆天然體用之法，無有一法能自越踰，亦無有一法能變易之也。或曰：如云天然體用者，是世間有為有相之法也。是出世法，無聖凡之得失，無迷悟之是非，何可以天然體用之法而比擬哉？予曰：子知心外無法，法外無心乎？佛祖出世之法，正以人不悟真如自性，而於根身器界妄生迷悟，而自異其性相之法也。不見《法華》云：「是法住法位，世間相常住。」以不壞世相而成法性乎？所以世尊付法偈曰：「法本法無法，無法法亦法，今付無法時，法法何曾法？」秖此一偈，便是佛祖天然體用不可變易之微妙法印也。若知此意，則知吾作《會祖規》以存東西密相付之根本法印，使後世子孫能悟此根本法印，則五家門庭堂奧之宗旨不致流弊而無傳也。或曰：《會祖規》乃會五家宗旨也，今五家秪有臨濟、曹洞二宗，而三宗之後無傳，又何以會乎？予曰：夫五家之宗旨即少林之宗旨也，既五家能悟少林之宗旨，豈有少林之宗旨不可以會五家門庭施設堂奧深微之宗旨哉？此吾深有望於具頂門眼、懸肘後符者，當使一花五葉之宗旨重重開敷於天下後世耳。或曰：近世叢林凋弊之極，不見漢官威儀久矣，況復得睹三代禮樂之猶在乎？今日吾師立此會祖圖規，以揭出西天東土及五家門庭堂奧之宗旨，實為天然體用不易之常法，亦乃振古所未有之奇特也。予曰：此不過竊取祖述於迦葉、達磨，憲章於馬、石五宗，以六種綱宗而集始終一貫之大成耳，豈別有所謂奇特之建立哉？會祖規小序會祖規小序或問：師著《尊正規》，以佛、菩薩及諸宗祖出世為人，種種經、律、論、藏、淨土、止觀、懺法等，門庭施設，堂奧深微，始終本末，折入禪宗，為集佛祖大成，已無餘蘊矣。茲又作會祖圖，獨以禪宗為一叢林之式。今天下諸家學人，見尊正規之妙，正恨其集會之未能，而師倏然復先折出禪宗，自作一家，無乃

Entries.SourceTerm: 法法本來法，無法無非法

Senses.PreferredTarget: Every teaching is originally teaching; there is no fixed teaching or nonteaching
AlternateTargets: Each teaching is originally teaching, with neither teaching nor its negation fixed
SearchAliases: every teaching original teaching no fixed teaching
Senses.Note: The inherited transmission verse says that each teaching is originally teaching, yet no teaching stands as a fixed teaching or its opposite. Baiyun asks how visible mountains, colors, and names fit a single teaching; Shitian points to the temple landscape and its several distinct things; Shishuang raises a staff and asks which is the original teaching; Yuelin asks the same of his staff; Yanxi places the verse on the listeners’ own brows and lashes. These five teachers actively test the inherited formulation in different present scenes.

Occurrences.Kwic: 洪山斷足，仰山作息。澄翠門下，朝朝入室。如上所供，並皆詣實。上堂：一法若有，毗盧墮在凡夫。萬法若無，普賢失其境界。正當與麼時，如何猛虎當路坐？上堂。臘盡春至，頭頭顯示，雪裏梅花，馨香撲鼻。喝一喝，云：認著依前還不是。上堂，眾集定，良久，云：露。便下座。上堂：一九與二九，相逢不出手。因甚不出手？免見揚家醜。上堂：山奇水秀洞中天，與麼分明知幾年？左右逢原無限意，幾人於此徹根源？住湖州烏回山密嚴禪寺語錄住湖州烏回山密嚴禪寺語錄侍者惠開編上堂。法法本來法，無法無非法。拈起拄杖云：這箇是烏回拄杖子，那箇是本來法？擲拄杖，下座。施主設粥開浴，請上堂。昨日入院，今朝設粥，齋罷喫茶，參前澡浴，箇是靈山親付囑。以拂子擊禪床，下座。除夜小參，云：朝朝相似，日日一般，年窮歲盡，盡底掀飜。且道掀飜後如何？依舊孟春猶寒。喝一喝，下座。上堂：人笑鵓鳩拙，鵓鳩自不拙。兩莖柴子上，一生打得徹。打刀須是并州鐵。上堂。身心一如，身外無餘，為什麼火熱水冷？喝云：一任安名立字。上堂：今朝四月一，結夏又在即。若是到家人，日日是好日

Occurrences.Kwic: 止一城。無毫髮間，無前後際。只今吳越令行，惱亂春風未已。中秋，上堂。有則水裡月，無則形名兆。以拂子打圓相，云：即此是達磨眼睛，亦謂之衲僧頂門竅。若也會得，二十年到曾與麼來；苟或未然，吞吐機前二俱失照。上堂：從上發大機，顯大用，捩手翻羹，轉喉觸諱。須知有德山棒，無下手處；有臨濟喝，無啟口分。雖然，不是苦心人不知。九月旦，石屏赴護國，上堂：東去西去，脚頭脚尾沒回互；南來北來，鐵壁銀山盡豁開。擬即失，動即乖。試看楊岐跨驢，何似玄沙斫牌？上堂：法法本來法，無法無非法。釋迦老子向諸人眉毛上豁開百千妙門，眼睫內廣演無量妙義。見你諸人不知不覺，已入摩竭陀國去也。何於一法中，有法有不法？資壽如菴一都寺施法被，陞座說偈：吾佛舒廣長舌相，不即此座亦不離，爾時寶積諸長者，持七寶蓋而獻佛。如菴道人道機熟，今亦即色以明心，攢花簇錦出新好，而以組綉作佛事。一一針孔一世界，一一花葉一如來，森羅萬象影重重，莫不一法之所印。此座非高亦非廣，此被非闊亦非狹，舒即大千悉彌滿，收入微塵不迫窄。譬如隨色摩尼珠，是被光明亦如是，晝夜

Senses.Explanation: “Every teaching is originally teaching; there is no fixed teaching or nonteaching” joins an affirmation to its refusal to become a rigid category. Baiyun asks how the many named things can be spoken of as one teaching, while Shitian points to the temple landscape. Shishuang and Yuelin each raise a staff to test the line; Yanxi places its force on the listeners’ own brows and lashes.

Senses.PreferredTarget: The Dharma has no fixed form; in meeting conditions it becomes the guiding principle.

Senses.Explanation: 法爾 means naturally so: something is as it is by its own course. Yongming Yanshou uses it adverbially when he says that anyone called a teacher naturally must understand the Buddha's words and confirm his own mind. Micang Kai writes that a brightness illuminating heaven and earth naturally blazes. Yushan Shangsi uses the expanded form 法爾如然, ‘naturally just so,’ beside 神通妙用, ‘wondrous function,’ but says that calling the conduct either one does not furnish an accomplished person with a good plan. A later lamp records an unnamed monk reversing the expression into a question—‘naturally so or not so?’—and asking Ruiyan Zihong for a direction. These uses range from an adverb modifying what happens as a matter of course to a predicative description of how something stands; none requires 法爾 to name a separate principle.

Entries.SourceTerm: 法界不容身，師還見我麼

Senses.PreferredTarget: If the realm of reality leaves no room for a body, do you still see me?
SearchAliases: if the realm of reality leaves no room for a body, do you still see me?
Senses.Note: While picking tea, Pang asks Zechuan, “If the realm of reality leaves no room for a body, do you still see me?” Zechuan answers obliquely, then ignores Pang’s further turns and finally takes up his tea basket. Yuanwu asks whether that silence counted as an answer. Fojian tests what the two moments of ignoring accomplished. Gulin answers the encounter with bitter gourd and sweet melon; Liao’an says a bodily move would have been sharper than the inherited comment about removing Pang’s cap. The question tests recognition in a meeting, not an abstract denial of bodies.

Senses.Explanation: A faculty or criterion for seeing and selecting the teaching. One direct definition says, 'nowhere not pervasive and nowhere not clear; therefore it is called the eye of the teaching.' In a recorded case, an unnamed participant asks what the eye of the teaching is and receives, 'the eye of the teaching has no flaw.' The productive phrase 'an eye that selects the teaching' appears in challenges to distinguish black from white and in the requirement that a lineage teacher possess such an eye. Transmission narratives also contain the pure eye of the teaching within an entrustment formula. These definitions, questions, compounds, and transmission uses establish a teaching faculty or criterion, not the person Fayan Wenyi.

Senses.Explanation: The Fayan lineage is the Zen house traced through Fayan Wenyi. The lineage manuals place Wenyi after Luohan Guichen; Hanyue Fazang says its purport is present in the six-aspect formulation; monks ask Cian Jingyuan and Langting Jingting what this lineage is in public interviews. Their answers characterize the named house and do not create a second referent.

Senses.Note: The English clause and noun reflect two local grammatical shapes: the boundary in 'all phenomena are empty' and the compact noun used for a category or seat. They remain one sense.

Senses.Explanation: “Phenomena are empty” says that things have no fixed reality; as a noun, “emptiness of phenomena” names that finding. Yongjia Xuanjue defines its discernment as seeing aggregates and other things as conditionally formed rather than real, like images in a mirror or the moon in water. Huangbo Xiyun gives the clause its compact form: because the mind is empty, phenomena are empty. Yongming Yanshou and Baoqin Rui each turn it into a seat from which buddhahood is presented.

Senses.Note: The assembly and its teaching seat are two sides of the same attested institutional setting here; generic ritual establishments are controls rather than a separate Chan sense.

Senses.Explanation: A teaching gate is a teaching or articulated approach presented as a gate of entry. Yang Jie's preface calls it a gate in which buddhas abide; a lamp master recalls one learned at age seven; Juelang Daosheng proclaims a great teaching gate opened. Nanyue Huairang compares a mind-ground teaching gate to seed, Shakyamuni names a subtle teaching gate in the raised Flower Sermon case, Dahui Zonggao says “this teaching gate,” and later hall addresses speak of a hundred thousand expedient gates or eighty-four thousand gates.

Senses.PreferredTarget: Conduct follows the teaching; its banner is raised wherever one goes
AlternateTargets: Act in accord with the teaching, and establish its banner in every place
SearchAliases: conduct follows teaching banner raised everywhere
teaching banner established wherever one goes
Senses.Note: The first clause calls for conduct in accord with the teaching; the second pictures the teaching banner raised wherever the work is carried. Ying'an, Xiaoyin, Yangzhuo, Feiyin, Cuiya, Beijian, and Xuzhou use the pair in present sermons about showing, transmitting, or establishing the teaching. Several immediately raise a staff or challenge the assembly. The banner is therefore an enacted public presence, joined to conduct rather than merely a claim of authority.

Occurrences.Kwic: 鼓陞堂，說無義語，有一句到汝諸人家國興盛，無一句到汝諸人四海晏清。拈露柱向燈籠上，將露柱掛燈籠邊，飢來喫飯，困即打眠，有甚麼事？若也不會，五月黃梅爛石臼。上堂：七佛已前，然燈已後，無人道著。因甚鷲嶺拈花，飲光微笑？國清才子貴，家富小兒嬌。佛涅槃，上堂。十五日已前今日有，十五日已後明日無。正當十五日，是有耶？是無耶？石頭大底大，小底小，野猿啼破千山曉。上堂，舉：教中道：遠離顛倒夢想，究竟涅槃。拋却甜桃樹，㳂山摘醋梨。者些消息子，能有幾人知？若也知，滿山花發杜䳌啼。撫州踈山白雲禪寺語錄撫州踈山白雲禪寺語錄住杭州靈隱禪寺法嗣淨伏編師入寺，指山門云：白雲高，灘水急，不動脚頭，全身直入。佛殿。前佛夜半逾城去，後佛天宮未下來，且道喚阿那箇作現在底？佛插香，云：因我得禮你。拈府䟽。花簇簇，錦簇簇，吟不足，詠不足，的的無絃琴上曲。陞座，拈香祝聖罷，乃云：大機圓應，大智無方，右左逢原，七穿八穴，萬疊雲山一抹過，十八灘頭聲浩浩，遇貴即貴，遇賤即賤，法隨法行，法幢隨處建立，要津把斷，縱奪臨時，風細細，日遲遲，四海浪平龍睡穩，九天雲淨鶴高飛。復舉雪竇明覺大師一日與李殿撰坐次，有一秀才一道士從外入來，撰云：三教中那教最尊？雪竇起身側立，撰云：有口何不道？雪竇云：對夫子以難言。師拈云：大小大明覺大師被殿撰一問，直得側身而立。然雖如是，要見雪竇則易，要見殿撰則難。也不難，也不易，必竟三教中那教最尊。卓拄杖一下，云：棊逢敵手，密行難藏；琴遇知音，希聲乃布。當晚，小參。四十年前錯訪尋，瓦爐煙斷白雲深，如今再到經行處，却憶無絃是賞音。是以，法無異法，心不自心，用不停機，隨宜應變，栴檀林裡噴伊蘭，無角鐵牛眠石室，不關萬象，幽旨互融，全主全賓，十方通暢。正與麼時如何委悉？靠拄杖，云：三尺冷光摩朅令，普天和氣少林春。復舉三聖示眾云：我逢人則出，出則不為人。興化道：我逢人則不出，出則便為人。師拈云：燕南趙北，各據封疆，可惜臨濟些子活計，被二子一時花擘了也。新踈山忍俊不禁，出來為他作箇中人，也是賊過後張弓。卓拄杖一下。上堂：謝川人俊，西堂春風卷春雨，春樹生春烟，作家相見不談禪。天寒燒榾柮，雲外煑清泉。更有一般風味在，從來附子出西川。涅槃，上堂。十五日已前，過山尋蟻跡；十五日已後，渡水覔魚蹤。正當十五日作麼生道？自徒

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 倆，我無伎倆；二千年後，我有伎倆，你無伎倆。何故？入水見長人。據室橫按拄杖，顧視左右，云：有麼？有麼？卓一下，云：無人過價，打與三百。拈院疏，云：箇是大丞相親受靈山記莂底句子，付在山僧，未聞者聞、未見者見。指法座，云：坐斷報化佛頭，不落玄玅階級。竇八布衫，雲門念七。陞座，拈香祝聖，問答罷，乃云：夫為宗師者，提持綱要，接物利生，豈是細事？況茲山千載名藍，五天化境，大丞相號令明肅，出於至公。山僧既已回避無門，諸人各要知時識節。拈拄杖，云：即心即佛，非心非佛。不是心，不是佛，不是物。三千年黃河清，五百載聖人出。復舉：僧問投子：諸佛出世為一大事因緣，和尚出世當為何事？投子云：尹司空為老僧開堂。師云：投子老人可謂應機施設，不犯鋒𨦵，中峰不免因齋慶讚。一髮由來引萬鈞，全肩荷負見當人。通身手眼重拈掇，枯木華開大地春。當晚，小參。凡夫色礙，二乘空礙，菩薩色空無礙。拈拄杖，云：拄杖子列列挈挈，不入眾數，有時十字街頭橫挑布袋，有時白雲景裏打雨敲風，法隨法行，法幢隨處建立，有佛處不得住，無佛處急走過，三千里外一句全提。畢竟如何話會？卓拄杖，云：一六三四二，直言曲七一，桃李火中開，黃昏候日出。復舉：南泉初入院，大眾送歸方丈，僧問：端居丈室將何指示於人？泉云：昨夜三更失却牛，天明起來失却火。師云：大小南泉和泥合水。中峰則不然，忽有問：端居丈室將何指示於人？即向他道：拄杖子今日開封。聖節，上堂。化工密運，納羣生於覆燾之中；端拱無為，躋四海於仁壽之域。如華藏海，融攝三千世界；似帝網珠，交羅百億山河。正與麼時，如何是不涉誕生底句？一氣不言含有象，萬靈何處謝無私？請頭首，上堂。騰今耀古，摩醯正眼洞明；鍛聖鎔凡，向上鉗鎚玅密。定佛祖綱宗之句，須是其人；展主賓互換之機，要求作者。所以道：作大廈，非一木能成；涉巨川，豈一棹可濟？直得照用同時，星飛電捲，人境俱奪，玉振金聲。正恁麼時，諸人鼻孔在山僧手裏。且道：山僧鼻孔在什麼處？擲拂子，云：一任橫拖倒拽。元旦，上堂。元正啟祚，萬物咸新，海宇歡呼，人天交慶。直得石女倒騎鐵馬，蹋破虗空；木人鞭動泥牛，耕翻碧落。阿呵呵，會也麼？有意氣時添意氣，不風流處也風流。上堂：靈雲桃華，光輝閃爍。趙州栢樹，築著磕著。大用現前兮，人人握靈蛇之珠。全機獨弄兮，箇箇抱荊山之璞。莫莫，抹過

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 厓厓。人知其一，未知其二。九會葛藤，自揚醜惡。從苗辨地，余言豈誣。眼裏無筋，此老受屈。淳祐辛亥解制前三日住冷泉大川北磵和尚語錄目次北磵和尚語錄目次台州般若院台州報恩孝寺湖州鐵觀音寺湖州西余大覺寺安吉州圓覺寺寧國彰教寺常州顯慶寺常州碧雲崇明寺平江府常熟縣慧日寺道場山護聖萬歲院淨慈山報恩光孝寺小參秉拂告香普說法語頌古偈頌贊小佛事No.1365北磵和尚語錄北磵和尚初住台州般若禪院語錄北磵和尚初住台州般若禪院語錄參學大觀編方丈方丈趂鼠入角，吹糠著米，直下翻身，劒去久矣。法座法座信脚行，信口道。一步登高，全身入草。知心若解相扶，好把禪床靠倒。祝香祝香此一瓣香，恭為今上皇帝祝延聖壽無疆，萬歲，萬歲，萬萬歲！次拈香，云：此一瓣香，奉為判府郎中、合郡官僚常居祿位。上堂上堂，舉：三聖、興化二大士，一人逢人則出，出則不為人；一人逢人則不出，出則便為人。師拈云：未出草廬，三分已定，惜乎規模大小了般若。出則出了也，且道是為人不為人？臨時散瑞，慶節升座。法隨法行，法幢隨處建立；空所空寂，空中現量涵容。譬如金毛嚬呻，入奮迅三昧，情與無情從風而靡，諸子傍睨，各增勇徤。又如迦陵頻伽在殻，氣宇英利，已壓眾羽。所以道：未離兜率，已生金輪萬乘之家；未誕無憂，已度塵沙無邊之眾。法如是故，豈假他求？󳭪󳭪然、晃晃然，逈出思議之表也。惟佛與佛乃知其真，天人群生類皆承此恩力。畢竟承誰恩力？一氣不言含有象，萬靈何處謝無私？上堂：面門一思，長時無間。便與麼去，討甚麼盌？得路塞路，看樓打樓。攀緣四天下，屋裏販楊州。上堂：無愧於心對聖僧，不圖人愛愛人憎。打刀不是并州鐵，誰與諸方剪葛藤？結夏，上堂。以大圓覺，為我伽藍，身心安居，平等性智。喫官酒，臥官街，當處死，當處埋，本來無位次，何用強安排？為施主升座，著脚於初步之地，如發機於千鈞之重，其至爾力也，然而不可不審；忘心於頓證之地，如破的於百步之外，其中非爾力也，然而不可不察。審而察之，則身心一如，心外無餘。至於百億法門、百億名義，涵攝密嚴，超越玄祕，在我衲僧門下，須知別有一家風月，橫拈倒用，放去收來，破二作三，課無責有。然雖如是，要覔他一毫頭許了不可得。且道衲僧有甚長處？從來汗馬無人識，只要重論盖代功。舉佛擊一髑髏，問耆婆云：此人生何處？婆云：生天。又擊一髑髏云：此人生何處？婆

Senses.Explanation: The rider is given a blue dragon yet cannot ride it: a sharp image for possessing a powerful means without knowing how to use it. Chushi, Yunwai, Guantao, Yushan, and Wuchu place it in distinct Chan verses or sermons; Yushan makes it his own closing challenge, while Wuchu turns it on the Yantou-Xuefeng encounter. Retained public meaning is supported by independent present uses in recorded discourse.
